title: Abraham Promise Map
purpose: Map the Genesis promise categories and distinguish later canonical interpretation.
body_markdown:
# Abraham Promise Map

Place **Abram** in the centre. Add branches for:

- Land
- Descendants / nation
- Name
- Blessing
- All families of the earth

Use a second colour for **Galatians 3** and write what Paul later connects to the promise.

## Guardrail

Do not translate “blessing” into guaranteed wealth or ease.
